steps.content: You have lost track of how long this deadly game of cat and mouse with the monster has lasted.
Suddenly, Ragnar beside you turns his head toward you with an unnaturally stiff motion, his cracked lips parting into a smile.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Dale?
You come to the realization that Ragnar isn't looking at you but at the porthole behind you.
You spin around to find a black diving suit pressed against the window. Its loose metal helmet sways in the current, repeatedly tapping against the submarine.
Pylgia drives her harpoon into the diving suit, forcefully prying it away.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Move the sub! That's not Dale; it's...
Before Pylgia can finish, a massive tentacle sweeps past, cutting off her warning. That fleeting moment reveals "Dale" in his entirety.
His body is inexplicably fused to the monster's tentacle, the diving suit distended with an unknown substance, making him look like a swollen water balloon.
At the same time, the impact kills the engine, and the screech of grinding metal threatens to rupture your eardrums.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Hahaha... So this is the way out...
All color has drained from Ragnar's pale face as he stares transfixed at the tentacles, his hands having long since abandoned the helm.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Go, it's catching up!
There's an unusual urgency in Pylgia's voice. But you don't need her warning to know the monster is breathing down your neck.
But Ragnar has completely lost his mind. He slumps in the pilot's seat, his face buried in his hands, emitting nothing but hoarse laughter.
As the submarine remains motionless in the water, the sound of breathing and static crackles through the radio. Outside the porthole, Pylgia glances back, her eyes indiscernible in the darkness.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: I'll hold it off.
In the boundless dark water of the Abyss, Pylgia raises her searchlight high and blasts a piercing beam directly into the giant creature's face.

The monster, having lurked in darkness since time immemorial, recoils from the intense light. Its strike, originally aimed at the submarine, goes wide, colliding with the rock wall with such force that the entire Abyss appears to tremble.
Shortly after, it notices the tiny figure that dares to provoke its might, unleashing its pale, slimy tentacles to lash viciously at Pylgia.
Pylgia dodges the lethal strike with incredible agility, yet there's no respite for her as more putrid tentacles come crashing towards her, one after another.

options: Try to snap Ragnar out of it

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wake up Ragnar! Pylgia's holding off the monster. Start the engine, right now!
The submarine violently shudders as tentacles outside exert unimaginable force, hurling the vessel deeper into the Abyss. The impact throws you to the floor.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We can't... let her effort go to waste...

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Go to waste... Ha... Hahaha... Don't you get it yet?

Ragnar turns his head with mechanical stiffness to gaze at you sprawled on the floor, his mouth stretching into an impossible grin, nearly reaching his ears, as black ooze seeps from his eyes, nostrils, and gums.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: It's all in vain... There's no escape... We're doomed... No... no...

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: It's been so many times... You knew it...! The moment we entered this... we... we were already dead...
Ragnar—no, this isn't Ragnar anymore. Some entity has seized control of his consciousness. It knows your history, cognizant of your countless futile struggles in the DisSea.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: You can't save her... or anyone... You never... belonged here...

Outside the submarine, Pylgia persists in her battle with the monster. Despite her unparalleled speed underwater, she's but a raft in a tempest, destined to be engulfed by the monster's relentless assault.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Ugh...
A muffled grunt of pain comes through the radio.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pylgia!
Pylgia offers no response. All you can hear is the endless rambling of "Ragnar" by your ears.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: This is... our... end...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pylgia, where are you?!
There's still one torpedo left on the sub—maybe you can use it to blast through the tentacles, but there's only writhing darkness wherever you peer. You can't even discern the target to strike.
Your hands tremble as rage and frustration scream to burst out of your chest, yet with nowhere to be vented.
Once again, a companion vanishes before your eyes. And once again, you are utterly powerless to stop it...

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: ...I'm fine.
Suddenly, Pylgia's weakened voice crackles through the radio.
The familiar figure appears outside the porthole. Harpoon gripped tight, Pylgia navigates through the onslaught of attacks as dense as a fishing net, turning the battle into a deadly dance.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: I... can try to hold it off for a while longer.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: If Ragnar couldn't make it, at least there's you...

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Start the engine and get out of here.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Get Ragnar and the collectors back... please.
Pylgia isn't dead yet, but like every companion before her, she is willing to sacrifice her life to light a path through the darkness.
But you refuse to let it end this way again—even if just this once, you want to save someone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's still a way. We can make it back together!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I won't let you go... Not any of you!
You must save Pylgia, and Ragnar, even though he is being possessed by something... Wait, or perhaps Ragnar is the key to all this.

He's slouching in the pilot's seat at the moment, his blood-red eyes locked on you in an unblinking gaze. If emotions can shape reality in the DisSea, maybe by stopping him from spreading fear is the way...
You grab the spare oxygen tank and smash it against Ragnar's head. Without a moment to react, his body shudders violently upon the impact before he collapses unconscious.
Almost instantly, the monster outside freezes mid-motion, like data running into an error. It hangs suspended in place, even the shrill screams falling silent.
However, the peace lasts only a moment before the creature resumes its movement. Yet this time, you unmistakably sense that its speed and strength have significantly waned.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pylgia, listen up. I'm taking the tiller now. We can still counterattack... There's still a chance.
You drag the unconscious Ragnar aside and take the pilot's seat, your hand fiercely gripping the torpedo launch button.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's one torpedo left. All we need is to find an opening...
Pylgia grasps the situation almost instantly. After taking a few breaths, she speaks with unwavering determination.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: I'll lure the tentacles away. Aim at me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What? But what about you?

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Trust me.
It's undoubtedly a plan bordering on madness. However, with only one torpedo remaining, you have just this one chance to strike.
You have no choice but to trust her—perhaps she is the only one in the world who could pull this off.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Okay... I trust you!
You restart the engine and turn the submarine around, your fingers clenched tightly on the torpedo launch button.

At the same time, Pylgia charges forward at an incredible speed, her harpoon paving the path ahead. In this instant, she resembles an unstoppable marlin as she dives headfirst into the tangle of tentacles.

She moves too fast and dives too deeply for the tentacles to catch up with her. As they pursue and jostle against each other in their chase, they inadvertently form a small pocket of space around Pylgia at the center.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Now!
Following Pylgia's signal, you press the torpedo launch button, your heart caught in your throat.
The gap between the tentacles is too narrow, and at such a high velocity, even Pylgia cannot feasibly alter her course. The torpedo will strike her, propelling her body directly into the monster.

But in that split second, Pylgia executes an impossible maneuver—she springs upward at the final instant, as the torpedo streaks past her in a flurry of bubbles and currents, descending deep into the tangle of tentacles.
The next moment, your vision is engulfed in the glaring explosion.
[Explosion]

The explosion unleashes a devastating shockwave, its force immediately hammering the submarine. The metal vessel tumbles in the powerful currents as you are tossed around the cabin like a rag doll in a spin cycle.
You struggle to your feet, pushing through the ringing in your ears and the throbbing headache, and stagger towards the porthole.
Outside lies pitch darkness, the submarine obstructed by drifting monster remnants. You reach for the radio.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pylgia, are you okay? Answer me!
The ringing in your ears drowns out all other sounds. You can't make out anything.
Where is she? Did she escape the blast? Is she hurt?
Questions flood your mind as you call out her name, again and again, your heart racing with desperate worry.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: I'm... fine...
At last, you discern Pylgia's voice. Enveloped in a gentle white radiance, she's fast approaching your location.
Accompanied by her side, white luminescent particles surge forth from behind her—the same plankton you have met before, beyond the Abyss, in... a not-so-distant dream.
They saved you before, and once again, they have helped Pylgia achieve this miraculous escape.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You made it!

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: We made it, together.
Pylgia's voice retains its usual composure yet is tinged with a hint of a smile.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: But, it's not dead.
A deep growl echoes from below. The explosion only managed to drive it back. You're not surprised—a monster that colossal wouldn't be easily vanquished.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: At least we've bought some time to escape.
You try to keep your voice light to reassure Pylgia... and yourself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's no time to waste. Show me the way, Pylgia. Let's... get out of the Abyss.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Mmm.
